documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-26, driven by strong occupancy and higher Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed. Management highlighted significant operational milestones, including the inauguration of the new Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block, expansion into advanced medical technologies like AI-driven adaptive radiation and robotic surgery, and the board's approval to construct a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for the financial year 2024-25, achieving an operating income of 1,37,111.30 lakhs and profit after tax of 20,894.62 lakhs. Management highlighted plans to expand capacity by adding 100 beds in the main campus and establishing a new 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai, with the OP block expected to be ready by the end of the year. The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend of 10 per share for the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand is continuously rising due to aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college experienced high demand for admissions with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work potentially commencing in the second quarter of 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block represents a capital investment of ₹120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made an investment of ₹47 Crore in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounted to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital is a 2000 bed facility and will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital. We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The OP block for the new Chennai project will be ready for operation by the year end.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made an investment of 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounted to 5,239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its solar capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the financial year 2024-25 was 15%.
Operating income for 2023-24 increased by 19.59% over the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The income from operations for the financial year 2023-24 was ` 1,21,955.27 Lakhs registering an increase of 19.59% over the previous year income of ` 101,974.68 Lakhs.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital recorded a landmark 75 ECMO runs in the year 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: In critical care, we recorded a landmark 75 ECMO runs in 2025 — the highest in Tamil Nadu — and became only the second hospital in the state to offer an “ECMO on Wheels” ambulance service.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ₹15/- per share for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by members, would involve a cash outflow of 1,641.34 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of 1,641.34 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and the need for uninterrupted operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: The work for constructing the 300-bed Paediatric Hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the OP block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in the region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
management_commitments.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
